mlog.access.buffersize.tip: Unprocessed graphics commands in the display's buffer
mlog.access.comparator.tip: Redstone strength a comparator reads from this block
mlog.access.controlled.tip: Whether this unit is controlled by a logic processor
mlog.access.dead.tip: Whether this unit is dead or removed
mlog.access.displayheight.tip: Height of the display canvas in pixels
mlog.access.displaywidth.tip: Width of the display canvas in pixels
mlog.access.emittedredstone.tip: Redstone strength this block emits itself
mlog.access.emptyslots.tip: Number of slots still empty in the container
mlog.access.filter.tip:
Item set in this block's filter slot
null when unset
mlog.access.firstitem.tip:
First item in the container
null when empty
mlog.access.flag.tip: Numeric flag value stored on a unit.
mlog.access.hardness.tip: Time it takes to break this block
mlog.access.hasblockentity.tip: Whether this block has a block entity
mlog.access.hasfluid.tip: Whether there is fluid at this position
mlog.access.hasnetwork.tip: Whether this block is part of a kinetic network
mlog.access.id.tip: Numeric registry ID of this object, used by Lookup
mlog.access.itemcapacity.tip: Maximum number of items this container holds
mlog.access.liquidcapacity.tip: Maximum amount of liquid this container holds
mlog.access.memorycapacity.tip: Number of slots this memory block can store
mlog.access.name: Name
mlog.access.networkcapacity.tip: Stress capacity of the whole kinetic network, in SU
mlog.access.networksize.tip: Number of blocks in the kinetic network
mlog.access.networksources.tip: Number of power sources in the kinetic network
mlog.access.networkstress.tip: Stress the whole kinetic network is using right now, in SU
mlog.access.operations.tip: Number of drawflush calls this display has received
mlog.access.overstressed.tip: Whether the kinetic network is overstressed
mlog.access.powercapacity.tip: Maximum power this block can store
mlog.access.progress.tip: Smelting progress of a furnace, 0 to 1
mlog.access.raining.tip: Whether it is raining at this position
mlog.access.redstone.tip: Redstone signal strength this block receives
mlog.access.size.tip: Number of elements in a queried result
mlog.access.slotfluid.tip:
Fluid in the given tank
null when empty
mlog.access.slotitem.tip:
Item in the given slot of a container
null when empty
mlog.access.solid.tip: Whether this block has a collision shape
mlog.access.speed.tip: Rotation speed of this block, in RPM
mlog.access.stresscapacity.tip: Stress this block provides, in SU
mlog.access.stressimpact.tip: Stress this block uses, in SU
mlog.access.totalitems.tip: Total number of items in the container
mlog.access.totalliquids.tip: Total amount of liquid in the container
mlog.access.value.tip:
Current value of the block's value setting
0 when it has none
mlog.access.valuerow.tip: Which row (mode) the current value is on; what a row means depends on the block
mlog.access.velocityx.tip: Velocity of this unit on the X axis
mlog.access.velocityy.tip: Velocity of this unit on the Y axis
mlog.access.velocityz.tip: Velocity of this unit on the Z axis
mlog.category.io.tip: Modify contents of memory blocks and processor buffers.
mlog.control.prop.filter.tip:
Set the filter slot to this item (write an @item name); write null to clear it.
Can specify the face to read
mlog.control.prop.redstone.tip:
Allow this block to receive redstone power
Can specify the face to be powered
mlog.control.prop.value.tip: Set the given row of a value setting to a value
mlog.enum.graphicstype.clear.tip: Fill the display with a color.
mlog.enum.graphicstype.color.tip: Set color for next drawing operations.
mlog.enum.graphicstype.image.tip:
Draw the icon of an item or block.
Example: [accent]@stone[] or [accent]@iron_ingot[].
mlog.enum.graphicstype.print.tip:
Draws text from the print buffer.
Only ASCII characters are allowed.
Clears the print buffer.
mlog.enum.messagetype.title: Title
mlog.enum.op.anglediff.tip: Absolute distance between two angles in degrees.
mlog.enum.op.emod.tip: True modulo, result sign comes from the divisor.
mlog.enum.op.equal.tip:
Equal. Coerces types.
Non-null objects compared with numbers become 1, otherwise 0.
mlog.enum.op.strictequal.tip:
Strict equality. Does not coerce types.
Can be used to check for [accent]null[].
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.approach.tip: Pathfind toward the position and stop within the radius.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.getblock.tip: Read the block and block entity at the position; writes null when out of range or unloaded.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.idle.tip: Halt the bound unit in place.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.itemdrop.tip: Put the unit's items into the target container.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.itemtake.tip: Take items from the target container.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.move.tip: Move in a straight line to the position, ignoring obstacles.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.pathfind.tip: Pathfind to the position, avoiding obstacles.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.stop.tip: Stop moving and clear the target.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.target.tip: Look at the coordinates, without moving; a non-zero [accent]shoot[] makes ranged units fire at the point.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.targetp.tip: Look at a target unit or block; a non-zero [accent]shoot[] makes the unit attack, and ranged units fire within range.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.unbind.tip: Release the bound unit and stop controlling it.
mlog.enum.unitcontroltype.within.tip: Write 1 or 0 depending on whether the unit is within the radius.
mlog.global.@links: Number of blocks linked to this processor
mlog.global.@wait: Message wait marker: the processor resumes after the previous message finishes
mlog.gui.edit.name: Name
mlog.gui.edit.name.label: Name:
mlog.gui.link.denied: This block requires a world processor to link
mlog.gui.link.far: Target is out of link range
mlog.gui.link.hint: Left-click a block to link or remove link, right-click or ESC to exit
mlog.lst.draw.tip:
Add an operation to the drawing buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Draw Flush[] is used.
mlog.lst.drawflush.tip: Flush queued [accent]Draw[] operations to a display.
mlog.lst.end.tip: Jump to the top of the instruction stack.
mlog.lst.explosion.tip: Create an explosion at a location.
mlog.lst.format.tip:
Replace next placeholder in text buffer with a value.
Does not do anything if placeholder pattern is invalid.
Placeholder pattern: "{[accent]number 0-9[]}"
Example:
[accent]print "test {0}"
format "example"
mlog.lst.getblock.tip:
Get the block registry id at a position.
Writes null if the chunk is not loaded.
mlog.lst.getflag.tip: Check if a global flag is set.
mlog.lst.getlink.tip: Get a processor link by index. Starts at 0.
mlog.lst.localeprint.tip:
Append localized text to the print buffer.
Resolved with the server language; truncated at the buffer limit.
mlog.lst.lookup.tip:
Look up an item/fluid/unit/block type by ID.
Total counts of each type can be accessed with:
[accent]@unitCount[] / [accent]@itemCount[] / [accent]@fluidCount[] / [accent]@blockCount[]
For the inverse operation, sense [accent]@id[] of the object.
mlog.lst.message.tip:
Display a message on the screen from the text buffer.
If the success result variable is [accent]@wait[],
will wait until the previous message finishes.
Otherwise, outputs whether displaying the message succeeded.
mlog.lst.packcolor.tip: Pack [0, 1] RGBA components into a single number for drawing or rule-setting.
mlog.lst.playmusic.tip:
Play a music track by name, e.g. [accent]@minecraft:music.game[].
If [accent]interrupt[] is true, the previously playing music will be stopped.
Playing with null music and interrupt set to true will stop the current track.
mlog.lst.playsound.tip:
Plays a sound.
Volume and pan can be a global value, or calculated based on position.
mlog.lst.print.tip:
Add text to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
mlog.lst.printchar.tip:
Add a UTF-16 character to the print buffer.
Does not display anything until [accent]Print Flush[] is used.
mlog.lst.printflush.tip: Flush queued [accent]Print[] operations to a sign.
mlog.lst.query.tip:
Queries units/buildings in a specified area.
Results are outputted into [accent]@queries[].
Results can be read from [accent]@queries[] using the [accent]Read[] instruction and an index.
Length of [accent]@queries[] can be sensed using [accent]@size[] as a parameter.
mlog.lst.read.tip:
Read a number from a linked memory cell.
Can also read from variables in other processors.
mlog.lst.select.tip: Conditionally set a variable to one of two values.
mlog.lst.sensor.tip: Get data from a building or unit.
mlog.lst.setblock.tip:
Set the block at a position.
Does nothing if the chunk is not loaded or the block name is invalid.
mlog.lst.setflag.tip: Set a global flag that can be read by all processors.
mlog.lst.setprop.tip: Sets a property of a unit or building.
mlog.lst.setrate.tip:
Set processor execution speed in instructions/tick.
Cannot surpass maximum execution speed.
mlog.lst.spawn.tip:
Spawn an entity at a position.
Writes the entity, or null on failure.
mlog.lst.status.tip: Apply or clear a status effect from a unit.
mlog.lst.ubind.tip: Bind to the next unit of a type, and store it in [accent]@unit[].
mlog.lst.ulocate.tip:
Find a block, the world spawn, or an injured mob around [accent]@unit[].
Block scans cover loaded chunks only and are cached for 20 ticks.
mlog.lst.unpackcolor.tip: Unpack RGBA components from a color that was packed using Pack Color.
mlog.lst.uradar.tip: Locate units around the currently bound unit.
mlog.lst.wait.tip: Wait a certain number of seconds.
mlog.lst.weathersense.tip: Check if a type of weather is active.
mlog.lst.weatherset.tip: Set the current state of a type of weather.
mlog.lst.write.tip:
Write a number to a linked memory cell.
Can also write to variables in other processors.
